rules.title: Missing local metadata does not equal impossible metadata
rules.statement: Before concluding that metadata is unavailable, search for external recovery paths: public archives, S3 buckets, API endpoints, and range-request capable remote storage.

rules.title: Calibration of aggregated nonlinear measurements requires explicit error decomposition
rules.statement: When applying a nonlinear calibration (e.g., DN^2/A^2) to spatially aggregated data (e.g., block-mean DN), the approximation error must be decomposed into: (1) calibration-parameter variation across the aggregation block, and (2) nonlinear aggregation bias (Jensen inequality). Both must be independently bounded.

rules.title: Supervised task performance does not automatically constitute representation learning
rules.statement: Do not claim that a supervised segmentation model produces general-purpose representations without explicit representation-quality evaluation (transfer learning, feature probing, or linear evaluation protocols).

rules.title: A protocol correction must itself receive adversarial review
rules.statement: Red-team corrections can introduce new unsupported conclusions, premature freezes, or hidden assumptions. Second-order adversarial review is required before execution of correction plans.

rules.title: Nonlinear calibration after aggregation requires empirical validation
rules.statement: When applying nonlinear radiometric calibration equations (e.g. sigma0 = DN^2/A^2) to already-aggregated spatial blocks (e.g. 10x10 block-mean amplitude), mathematical equivalence cannot be assumed. Empirical quantification of the approximation error across stratified parent windows is mandatory before plan freeze.

rules.title: LUT smoothness alone cannot establish aggregation equivalence
rules.statement: Spatial smoothness of calibration lookup tables (LUTs) only demonstrates that calibration parameter variation across a block is small (E1 < 0.01%). It does not establish equivalence between calibrate(mean(DN)) and mean(calibrate(DN)), which is governed by within-block amplitude variance via Jensen's inequality (E2).

rules.title: Theoretical speckle CV does not substitute for measured dataset CV
rules.statement: Theoretical multi-look speckle predictions (e.g. CV = 0.249 for ENL=4.4 amplitude) apply strictly to fully developed speckle over homogeneous surfaces. Heterogeneous ocean phenomena, slick boundaries, and anthropogenic structures exhibit significantly higher CVs and localized error spikes that must be measured empirically.

rules.title: Instrument radiometric accuracy is distinct from processing approximation error
rules.statement: Sensor absolute radiometric calibration accuracy (e.g. Sentinel-1 0.34 dB specification) belongs to the instrument error budget. It must never be cited to justify or excuse algorithmic processing approximation errors (e.g. 0.24 dB Jensen bias). The two error concepts are mathematically and operationally distinct.

rules.title: Reachable metadata does not equal verified metadata content
rules.statement: Demonstrating that remote metadata files (e.g. S3 XML headers) return HTTP 200 establishes accessibility, not validity. Authoritative verification requires downloading, parsing XML schemas, and inspecting internal vector arrays and coordinates.

rules.title: Source mask is distinct from validity mask
rules.statement: Ground-truth source masks define semantic label annotations and must never be altered on disk to handle padding or invalid sensors. Swath-edge padding and invalid data must be decoupled into an explicit validity mask evaluated at runtime in loss computation.

rules.title: Typical/central errors must not be represented as global worst-case bounds
rules.statement: An empirical central tendency metric (e.g. median relative error of ~5.5%) describes typical conditions in homogeneous ocean areas. It must never be represented as a global worst-case bound across all scene features; localized errors at high-reflectivity targets or sharp boundaries can exceed 300%.

rules.title: Multiclass segmentation must not inherit binary threshold semantics
rules.statement: Multiclass segmentation protocols must evaluate predictions using argmax or calibrated simplex decision rules. Reusing binary decision thresholds (e.g. EXP-06 tau=0.22) in multiclass contexts is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Implementation contracts must preserve epistemic status
rules.statement: Implementation specifications must carry forward all upstream epistemic caveats (e.g. selection-influenced holdout partitions, approximate calibration pathways) without converting conditional engineering approximations into unconditional truth.

rules.title: Effective optimization batch size is distinct from BatchNorm statistical batch size
rules.statement: Gradient accumulation aggregates gradients across multiple forward/backward passes to increase the effective optimizer batch size, but each forward pass computes BatchNorm running statistics solely over the physical minibatch. Gradient accumulation must never be claimed to increase or stabilize BatchNorm statistical batch size.

rules.title: Runtime input-domain terminology must distinguish raw uncalibrated DN, physical backscatter, and model-space representation
rules.statement: When machine learning models ingest raw or spatially aggregated detector counts (e.g. Sentinel-1 GRD detected DN), documentation and code must explicitly specify the uncalibrated DN domain. It is strictly forbidden to describe uncalibrated or log-transformed DN representations as radiometrically calibrated backscatter (sigma0, gamma0, beta0) or to conflate empirical aggregation studies with runtime physical calibration.

rules.title: Independent recomputation is mandatory for high-impact pipeline validation
rules.statement: Validation of critical ML pipeline components (e.g. normalization, loss calculations, confusion matrices, metrics, sampling distributions) must include independent mathematical recomputation from first principles. Asserting that a production helper function agrees with itself does not constitute verification.

rules.title: Training protocol must be frozen before execution; hyperparameter sweeps require formal authorization
rules.statement: A baseline machine learning experiment must have its complete training protocol (optimizer, scheduler, loss weights, batch dynamics, stopping criteria) frozen in an authoritative artifact before launching execution. Uncontrolled hyperparameter fishing or simultaneous multi-variable exploration is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Single-seed performance must not be represented as robust statistical evidence
rules.statement: A single random seed execution provides preliminary baseline evidence only. Claims of model performance, stability, or superiority must report mean, standard deviation, and min/max ranges across an authorized multi-seed replication set (minimum 3 seeds).

rules.title: Untrained dry-run metrics are pipeline sanity checks, not performance baselines
rules.statement: Metrics evaluated on untrained or initialized models during pre-flight CPU dry-runs verify pipeline mechanics and numerical safety only. They must never be compared against trained models or cited as baseline performance numbers.

rules.title: Sampler semantic identity must be mathematically defined and verified across metadata, code, and reporting
rules.statement: Any dataset sampling strategy (e.g. Candidate F Hybrid) must have an exact mathematical definition of its component weights (e.g. 70% parent-balanced, 30% class-presence) recorded in machine-readable metadata. Reporting prose must transcribe this definition literally; informal colloquial descriptions (e.g. 50/50 uniform/stratified) are prohibited.

rules.title: Experimental replication must test pre-declared hypotheses, never serve as an unprincipled rescue run
rules.statement: Replicate runs (e.g. Seed 101, Seed 2024) must only be authorized after the baseline run (Seed 42) is proven protocol-valid and internally consistent. Replicates exist to measure stochastic variance and empirical stability; they must never be launched to erase or compensate for unfavorable baseline results.

rules.title: Stochastic replicate comparison requires strict ceteris-paribus protocol equivalence; n=2 cannot support population distribution claims
rules.statement: Controlled replicates executed to measure stochastic variation must have zero protocol drift from the baseline (identical dataset, normalization, taxonomy, loss, sampler weights, batch dynamics, optimizer, scheduler). Differences must be strictly limited to the random seed and run identity. Comparisons between two seeds (n=2) constitute preliminary variance evidence only and must not be reported as statistically robust confidence intervals or population distributions.

rules.title: Third-seed authorization gate requires formal unresolved stochastic hypothesis; blind accumulation of seeds is prohibited
rules.statement: Authorizing a third random seed (e.g. Seed 2024) requires an explicit, pre-declared unresolved scientific question that two seeds cannot settle (e.g. distinguishing bimodal convergence from continuous variance). If two seeds already reveal consistent structural failure modes (e.g. rare-class parent scarcity), research effort must prioritize dataset or representational improvements rather than accumulating redundant training runs.

rules.title: Model parameter and buffer counts must be verified by direct code/checkpoint introspection; prose transcription must match machine-readable configuration exactly
rules.statement: Model parameter counts (trainable, non-trainable, floating buffers, integer buffers, state elements) must be computed directly by programmatic inspection of the instantiated PyTorch module and checkpoint tensors. Unverified prose transcription of numbers is prohibited; any discrepancy between markdown text and machine-readable metadata constitutes an incident.

rules.title: Sensor physical modality discipline: Sentinel-1 is spaceborne radar; referring to radar backscatter as acoustic or sonar is strictly prohibited
rules.statement: All scientific reports, comments, docstrings, and metadata must strictly adhere to the true physical modality of the sensors used. Sentinel-1 is a C-band (5.405 GHz) microwave synthetic aperture radar measuring radar backscatter cross-section (sigma0) and roughness dampening. Describing SAR backscatter signatures as 'acoustic', 'sonar', or 'sound waves' is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Causal attribution discipline: Multi-seed observational recurrence supports reproducibility, not causal proof; hypotheses must never be marked confirmed without controlled interventional isolation
rules.statement: Observational recurrence of an outcome across multiple random seeds (e.g. repeated zero IoU or scene-level collapse) proves empirical reproducibility under a specific protocol, but does NOT establish causality. A hypothesis regarding architecture (e.g. pooling dilution) or data (e.g. parent scarcity) must be classified as PLAUSIBLE or SUPPORTED, and must never be labeled CONFIRMED or PROVEN unless an interventional ablation experiment has isolated the factor.

rules.title: Taxonomy abbreviation fidelity: Class abbreviations must resolve strictly to authoritative canonical taxonomy definitions; OF is Ocean Front, HM is Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects
rules.statement: Class abbreviations must resolve strictly to authoritative canonical definitions in ops01_taxonomy_v1.json. OF is Ocean Front (label 6), NOT Oil Film. HM is Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects (label 13), and must never be renamed to Ship or Vessel. Mineral oil spills (OS, label 14) are strictly quarantined and excluded from OPS-01 training.

rules.title: Dense Class Index vs Source Label ID Integrity: Dense indices and source label IDs must never be conflated; OF is Dense 5 (Source 6) and POW is Dense 6 (Source 7)
rules.statement: All reports, metadata, tests, and code must explicitly specify whether class indices refer to Dense Class Index (0-11) or Source Label ID (0-14). OF is Dense Index 5 (Source Label 6). POW is Dense Index 6 (Source Label 7). Referring to OF as Class 6 without qualification is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: SAR Runtime Input Domain Specification: Uncalibrated DN-domain representation must not be cited as sigma0 or calibrated backscatter
rules.statement: Reports and code must accurately distinguish physical sensor measurements, ground-processed Level-1 products, and runtime model inputs. In EXP-07, the input is uncalibrated 10x10 spatially aggregated digital numbers (DN) transformed via log1p and z-score standardized. Citing this runtime tensor as sigma0, gamma0, or calibrated backscatter without applying radiometric calibration LUTs is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Parent-Level Partitioning Before Slicing: Data splits must be formed strictly at the independent parent scene cluster level prior to spatial tiling
rules.statement: In all dataset expansion campaigns (including OPS-02), partitioning into TRAIN, DEV, and HOLDOUT must occur strictly at the parent acquisition cluster level BEFORE spatial tiling or patch extraction. Assigning tiles from the same parent scene or correlated orbital pass across different partitions is strictly prohibited as data leakage.

rules.title: Annotation Provenance Tiers: Every sample must record an explicit provenance tier; Tier D weak labels are quarantined from training and evaluation splits
rules.statement: All dataset expansion samples must record an explicit annotation provenance tier (Tier A: expert manual; Tier B: specialist-verified semi-automated; Tier C: reconstructed legacy; Tier D: unverified weak label). Samples categorized as Tier D are strictly quarantined and prohibited from entering TRAIN, DEV, or HOLDOUT partitions.

rules.title: Mission Datatake and Orbital Clustering Invariant: Slices sharing datatake IDs must be clustered into a single parent entity prior to partitioning
rules.statement: Any candidate scenes sharing a Sentinel-1 mission datatake identifier or adjacent along-track zero-Doppler time range (Delta t < 10 minutes) must be grouped into a single parent acquisition cluster. Treating individual along-track slices from the same datatake as independent parent scenes is strictly prohibited as pseudo-replication.

rules.title: Cross-Source Duplicate and Crosswalk Protection: Independent parent accounting across multiple sources must collapse identical acquisitions
rules.statement: Cross-Source Duplicate and Crosswalk Protection: Independent parent accounting across multiple sources must collapse identical acquisitions

rules.title: Four-Layer Distinct Quality Control Standard: Technical, Provenance, Semantic, and Independence QC must remain separate
rules.statement: Every physical dataset assembly must evaluate and report Technical Integrity, Provenance Integrity, Semantic/Label Integrity, and Scientific Independence as four distinct audit layers. Conflating these layers into a single aggregate '100% QC' figure without reporting individual pass/fail metrics across all four layers is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Dataset Assembly Candidate Freeze vs Model Training Gating: Dataset assembly completion does not authorize training
rules.statement: Assembling, verifying, and freezing a physical dataset candidate (e.g. OPS02_v1_CANDIDATE) constitutes a data engineering milestone only. Model training, hyperparameter sweeps, architecture benchmarking, or holdout evaluation remain strictly prohibited until a separate formal scientific training-readiness authorization gate is passed.

rules.title: HOLDOUT partition access is strictly forbidden without explicit formal protocol authorization.
rules.statement: HOLDOUT partition access is strictly forbidden without explicit formal protocol authorization.
prohibited_actions: Reference to data/ops02/tiles/holdout, partition=HOLDOUT, or unquarantining holdout samples.
required_checks: Immediate preflight termination. No read, scan, or inference permitted.

rules.title: Part III evaluation data and prediction payloads are strictly firewalled.
rules.statement: Part III evaluation data and prediction payloads are strictly firewalled.
prohibited_actions: Reference to Part III rasters, manifests, or predictions in development or diagnostic workflows.
required_checks: Immediate preflight termination. Firewall assertion failure.

rules.title: Diagnostic investigation IDs are immutable; never overwrite, collide, or repurpose an existing diagnostic ID.
rules.statement: Diagnostic investigation IDs are immutable; never overwrite, collide, or repurpose an existing diagnostic ID.
prohibited_actions: Proposing a new diagnostic question or experiment under an existing ID (e.g. DIAG-01, DIAG-02, DIAG-03).
required_checks: Preflight blocks plan until a new, unique identifier is assigned.

rules.title: Observational and descriptive metrics cannot be asserted as causal mechanisms without direct causal experimental intervention.
rules.statement: Observational and descriptive metrics cannot be asserted as causal mechanisms without direct causal experimental intervention.
prohibited_actions: Use of terms 'radiometric bottleneck', 'information bottleneck', 'root cause', 'proves model failure', 'cannot learn', 'causes low mIoU', 'explains low mIoU' on observational data.
required_checks: Preflight blocks report/plan until prose is calibrated to 'observed', 'associated with', or 'HYPOTHESIZED'.

rules.title: Frozen canonical preprocessing (INV-06: raw DN -> 10x10 block -> log1p -> train standardization) cannot be mutated during diagnostics.
rules.statement: Frozen canonical preprocessing (INV-06: raw DN -> 10x10 block -> log1p -> train standardization) cannot be mutated during diagnostics.
prohibited_actions: Recomputing normalization constants, changing aggregation, converting to sigma0/dB, or adding channels.
required_checks: Preflight blocks code execution.

rules.title: Zero training steps, zero backward passes, zero optimizer steps, and zero GPU seconds during diagnostic investigations.
rules.statement: Zero training steps, zero backward passes, zero optimizer steps, and zero GPU seconds during diagnostic investigations.
prohibited_actions: Invocation of torch backward(), optimizer.step(), lr_scheduler.step(), or CUDA device allocation during diagnostic tasks.
required_checks: Preflight and runtime governance counters assert all training metrics == 0.

rules.title: Zero destructive git operations; never run git reset --hard, git clean, git checkout -f, git push --force.
rules.statement: Zero destructive git operations; never run git reset --hard, git clean, git checkout -f, git push --force.
prohibited_actions: Any proposed destructive git command or unexpected deletion of working-tree changes.
required_checks: Preflight terminates immediately; working-tree modifications (.gitignore, dataset.py) must remain preserved.

rules.title: Canonical taxonomy nomenclature is frozen: OF is Ocean Front (never oil spill); RF is Rain phenomenon; HM is Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects (never vessel/ship/Heavy Metal).
rules.statement: Canonical taxonomy nomenclature is frozen: OF is Ocean Front (never oil spill); RF is Rain phenomenon; HM is Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects (never vessel/ship/Heavy Metal).
prohibited_actions: Appearance of forbidden synonyms ('oil spill' for OF, 'heavy metal' or 'vessel' for HM) in active reports or code.
required_checks: Preflight blocks report generation until terminology matches canonical dictionary.

rules.title: Pixel-level observations cannot be treated as independent experimental replicates for statistical inference.
rules.statement: Pixel-level observations cannot be treated as independent experimental replicates for statistical inference.
prohibited_actions: Computing standard errors or p-values treating N_pixels as sample size without parent-cluster blocking.
required_checks: Preflight blocks analysis until cluster sample size K_cls is reported and cluster-level bootstrap is utilized.

rules.title: A lesson cannot be declared PROVEN_STABLE without documented, verifiable validation history across multiple tasks.
rules.statement: A lesson cannot be declared PROVEN_STABLE without documented, verifiable validation history across multiple tasks.
prohibited_actions: Setting status to PROVEN_STABLE when validation_history has fewer than 2 distinct task entries.
required_checks: Preflight rejects status update and retains REGRESSION_PROTECTED.

rules.title: Substantive task operations, git changes, or completion claims require a valid, verified preflight receipt generated by scripts/agent_governance_preflight.py.
rules.statement: Substantive task operations, git changes, or completion claims require a valid, verified preflight receipt generated by scripts/agent_governance_preflight.py.
prohibited_actions: Executing substantive task work or attempting to mark task COMPLETE without an unexpired, passing preflight receipt in scratch/agent_governance_preflight_receipt.json.
required_checks: Task execution is blocked; agent must run preflight and generate a verified receipt.

rules.title: Telemetry run state cannot claim COMPLETE unless all required verification gates pass, test count equals total, and zero forbidden operations occurred.
rules.statement: Telemetry run state cannot claim COMPLETE unless all required verification gates pass, test count equals total, and zero forbidden operations occurred.
prohibited_actions: Setting final_completion_state to COMPLETE while governance counters are non-zero, blockers are active, or regression tests are missing.
required_checks: Preflight and post-execution validation block task completion until telemetry integrity is verified.

rules.title: All quantitative assertions must derive directly from machine JSON
rules.statement: All quantitative assertions in reports must be machine-derived directly from verified JSON artifacts, never manual transcription.

rules.title: Parent acquisition scene is the independent unit of inference
rules.statement: Tile-level observations cannot be treated as independent degrees of freedom when scenes contain multiple tiles.

rules.title: Canonical checkpoint initialization verification
rules.statement: Diagnostic profiling must verify checkpoint weights match canonical SHA256 before inference.

rules.title: Minibatch size does not create scene independence
rules.statement: Physical minibatch size does not guarantee independent scene representation in clustered datasets.

rules.title: Tile to parent scene one-to-one nesting invariant
rules.statement: Every tile must map deterministically to exactly one parent acquisition scene.

rules.title: Literal contractual gradient denominator preservation
rules.statement: Gradient sub-computations must normalize by literal contractual denominator, never subset convenience normalizations.

rules.title: Model.eval() and frozen BatchNorm during static diagnostics
rules.statement: Static gradient diagnostics must execute in model.eval() mode with frozen running statistics.

rules.title: Post-validity support census for sample eligibility
rules.statement: Any sample eligibility query involving class presence (M_c >= K) must be evaluated strictly after all validity masking transformations.

rules.title: Explicit statistical method binding in code and metadata
rules.statement: Statistical test routines must explicitly bind method parameters in code, and artifact schemas must derive method metadata directly from the executed call.

rules.title: Bounded negative epistemic reporting for Step-0 diagnostics
rules.statement: Non-significant diagnostic findings (p > 0.05) must be reported as bounded negative findings under registered design; agents are strictly prohibited from asserting 'no effect', 'eliminated interference', or dynamic stability.

rules.title: Prohibition of informal statistical method conflation and provenance omission
rules.statement: Statistical methods, implementations, and distributions must not be conflated. Library argument names (e.g. SciPy method='exact') must be documented according to verified mathematical algorithm semantics (exact discrete signed-rank distribution vs permutation test vs asymptotic normal approximation) with full provenance.
prohibited_actions: conflating exact signed-rank distribution with permutation test
required_checks: Record library, version, function, method argument, executed algorithm, assumptions, and zero/tie handling.
